findings.one_line: The stated project promises the sharp shrinking-radius frontier, but this theorem supplies only a strict upper-envelope tightening and explicitly leaves the residual wedge (including the benchmark) open; it must be positioned and routed as a partial frontier result rather than the promised resolution.

The displayed rate is computable, but its d>n branch and the claimed selected total estimator depend on an unnamed, unconstructed "T^{par}" imported from the parent, so the Stat deliverable does not itself expose a usable estimator on all declared inputs and samples.

Positioning identifies the closest published and accepted-parent brackets, but the several listed polynomial/modulus comparators are grouped as generic architectural background without individual relevance or theorem-level distinctions; supply targeted comparisons or remove peripheral citations.
